breakdown.description: The prompt mixes true and engineering measures by using the current area and current length while asking for engineering stress and engineering strain.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification repeated the error from the incomplete prompt. It explicitly computes engineering strain using the current elongated length (Lcurrent = 50.12 mm) in the denominator: εeng,current = ΔL/Lcurrent = 0.12/50.12 = 0.002394. The correct engineering strain uses the initial gage length: ε = ΔL/L0 = 0.12/50 = 0.0024. Additionally, it frames the stress calculation as using 'current area' (even though it numerically equates it to A0). The ground truth simply asks for standard engineering stress (P/A0) and engineering strain (ΔL/L0) without mixing in true/instantaneous measures.
